title: Structural Intelligence Framework: An Open Architecture for Intelligence Localization, Composition, Governance, and Structural Growth
description:
The Structural Intelligence Framework (SIF) is a proposed open research architecture for locating, composing, governing, validating, and evolving heterogeneous intelligence structures. Its four functional domains are intelligence localization, per-node intelligence, universal control planes and scoring/folding, and residual-based structural growth. The initial research release introduces problem–capability dual maps, structural precedent intelligence, universal naming/typing/relay, structural intelligence contracts, portable intelligence pieces and units, multi-intelligence adversarial validation, structural counter-evidence, collective learning, and exploratory hypotheses concerning higher-order intelligence and the structural perception horizon.

Version 1.0.0 contains 18 research manuscripts, four candidate technical specifications, and three research planning documents. The architecture and specifications are research proposals, not experimentally validated standards or claims of achieved artificial superintelligence.
notes: Initial conceptual research release. The four specifications are candidate research designs requiring conformance testing and independent validation.
